translations.name: HappyBottoms
translations.description: HappyBottoms gives free diapers to families who need help and have children under age 4. You must live in an area HappyBottoms serves. Choose a diaper pickup location near you. Bring a document with your child’s name and birth date. Some locations ask you to sign up online first.
translations.website_description: Find a place to get free diapers in the Kansas City area.
